subject: Coverage tilt: action roster and commit asks
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Coverage tilt: initial snapshot + asks

Team — attaching a short snapshot of Acme (attached: coverage_snapshot_Q2.xlsx) and a proposed action roster to tighten commit coverage into the close window. High level: we’re ~38% covered vs. Q3 quota for the ACME deal cluster; pipeline shows 3 late-stage deals (incl. ACME) with weak next-step cadence.

Quick asks: 
- Marcus: can you validate the next-step/commit status for the three named opportunities in the sheet by EOD Tuesday? Mark any that are at-risk for loss of momentum.
- Laura: finance needs a short note on likely arrival windows by stage for modeling — can you draft a 2-line timing assumption for each op?
- Marissa: can you lead a 15-min commit calibration on Thursday (11:30am PT) to assign owners and hard next steps?

Notes in the sheet: color-coded confidence (green/yellow/red) + suggested coverage top-ups (discount credit, POC extension window). I flagged the Acme procurement contact as conversational but undecided.

Thanks — olga

Attachments: coverage_snapshot_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage tilt: initial snapshot + asks

On Tue, Jun 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — attaching a short snapshot of Acme ...

I pulled updates this morning and walked the three named opps with SDR and AE notes. Short summary: 
- ACME-ENTERPRISE (primary): buyer active; procurement paused to review data residency clause. AE says legal is looped but timeline slipped ~2w. Marked yellow.
- ACME-PAYMENTS (secondary): POC delivered; usage looks healthy but exec sponsor out until 6/15. Marked yellow->red on arrival risk.
- ACME-OPS (tertiary): low engagement, needs re-qualify call. Marked red.

I updated the sheet; I recommend a targeted credit + short-term SOW for Enterprise to buy us time while legal clears. Marcus will run down procurement contact tonight.

Attachment referenced: MAP_Acme_v2.pdf (proposal, 95KB)

Marcus
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-03T08:49:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage tilt: initial snapshot + asks

Thanks for the heads-up, Olga. Quick timing assumptions for modeling (2-line each):
- ACME-ENTERPRISE: legal clearing, estimate close window 6/28–7/12 (best estimate 07/02).
- ACME-PAYMENTS: dependent on exec sponsor return; assume 7/20 earliest.
- ACME-OPS: re-qualify, assume slip to next quarter (no recognition in Q3).

Finance note: if we push a credit/temporary SOW for Enterprise, treat it as contingent revenue until contract fully executed — model at 40% recognition risk.

I’ll join the calibration on Thursday, will bring the run-rate impact by scenario.

Laura
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Corp <procurement@acme.com>; Jessica Kim <jessica.kim@fincorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-04T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Coverage tilt: initial snapshot + asks

Folks — quick recap from the calibration today and external outreach I did with Acme procurement this afternoon: 

1) Internal commitments:
- Marcus to get final legal contact name + ETA by 6/6.
- Marcus to push updated MAP_Acme_v2.pdf that includes a 30-day provisional SOW option.
- Laura to provide scenario run-rates (base / credit-topup / delay) by EOD 6/5.
- Olga to approve the credit playbook threshold (max allowed discount for provisional SOW).

2) External: spoke briefly with Acme procurement (procurement@acme.com). They confirmed legal review but said a short provisional SOW to start integrations would help preserve momentum — fine to treat as a time-limited pilot. They asked for the SOW redline and a list of what data stays in region.

3) Immediate action items (owners & deadlines):
- Marcus: procurement contact + redline-ready SOW draft (6/6).
- Laura: scenario impacts (6/5).
- Olga: finalize credit ceiling and approval path (6/6).
- Marissa: coordinate follow-up with Acme and schedule exec sponsor meeting if Marcus confirms legal lead (6/8).

Attachments: MAP_Acme_v2.pdf (proposal, 95KB); coverage_snapshot_Q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

Marissa
